name: clean_orders
description: Cleans every orders-*.csv (or the listed files) from data/raw into data/clean with the same name: normalized header, ISO dates, capitalized customers, 2-decimal amounts, dedup by id, sorted by id. Returns per-file row counts (in, out, dropped, duplicates).
whenToUse: Whenever raw order CSV exports need cleaning, including newly arrived files; omit files to process all of data/raw.

dir.description: Source directory relative to project root; default data/raw

files.description: File names inside data/raw; default all *.csv

provenance.reason: clean 8 messy CSVs now and more exports later
